subject: Dedicated GPU pool — special pricing & throughput guarantee
messages:
From: Evan Brooks <evan@novaanalytics.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@novaanalytics.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Inquiry: Dedicated GPU pool sizing + pricing (competitive offer)

Hi Monica,

Thanks again for yesterday's demo — the throughput numbers looked very promising. We spoke internally and have two immediate asks as we evaluate Redwood for a production inference baseline:

1) A recommended GPU pool configuration for our peak inference profile (avg request length ~60 tokens, 30 r/s sustained, + burst to 100 r/s).
2) A pricing proposal for a 12-month reserved commit with a throughput SLA (p99 per-token latency target) and an ask for a commercial credit to match a competing vendor's effective TCO.

We received a competing term sheet this morning that includes an up-front credit and a stepped commit to match our expected growth. I attached a short Excel with our expected monthly token volumes and a sample throughput curve.

Can you confirm if Redwood can provide a competitive credit and a written throughput guarantee? Procurement would like a short commercial proposal and SLA language by early next week.

Thanks,
Evan Brooks
Director of ML Platforms
NovaAnalytics

Attachment: nova_volume_profile.csv (attached)
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evan Brooks <evan@novaanalytics.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@novaanalytics.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 17:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Inquiry: Dedicated GPU pool sizing + pricing (competitive offer)

Hi Evan — great to hear the demo was useful.

Short answer: yes. We can design a Dedicated GPU pool to hit your 30 r/s steady state with 100 r/s burst and back that with a throughput SLO. For the commit/credit ask, I want to loop in my manager for approval on any deviation from standard Reserved Commit discounts.

I'm attaching a draft tiered pricing worksheet and a proposed SLA summary for throughput/latency that maps to your token profile. If you can confirm the attached volume tab aligns with your internal forecast, I can put together a formal commercial term sheet.

I'll introduce Vivek (cc'd) to review the customer credit concession. Vivek — quick read: NovaAnalytics is strategic for us in analytics verticals and has a procurement ask to match a competitor's effective TCO via an up-front credit + stepped commit. Proposed technical config: 4x A100-equivalent GPUs (pool size) with autoscale headroom to 8 for bursts; target p99 token latency <= 120ms for the 60-token average.

Next steps: Evan, if that config looks reasonable, can you confirm final expected monthly token volume and any compliance requirements? Procurement mentioned SOC2 evidence — we can provide the standard pack.

Regards,
Monica Patel
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: nova_draft_tiered_pricing.xlsx (pricing/workload), proposed-sla-throughput.pdf (SLA draft)
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 01 May 2027 09:46:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Dedicated GPU pool — special pricing & throughput guarantee

Vivek/Laura — forwarding Evan's ask and the draft pricing/SLA. Quick summary below and request:

- Account: NovaAnalytics (strategic analytics prospect).
- Ask: 12-month reserved commit with an up-front commercial credit to match competitor (they cited a $250k effective credit on year-one TCO).
- Technical: 4x A100-eq pool for steady 30 r/s, autoscale to 8 for bursts; throughput SLA (p99) target ~120ms for avg 60-token requests.
- Proposed commercial offer (see attached): standard reserved discount + an additional one-time credit spread over month 1-3; list pricing impact in the attached workbook.

Would you approve up to a $200k credit and flexibility on the commit ramp (stepped commit months 1-3) constrained by a longer commit term (12 months) and a small uplift on unit price if they don't hit steerage volumes? If you approve, I will send a formal term sheet and get DocuSign started — procurement expects a signed agreement within two weeks.

Thanks — Monica

Monica — thanks for the summary. A few thoughts:

1) Strategic value: NovaAnalytics is a strong reference in finance/retail analytics; we should weigh the long-term ARR potential against the near-term credit.
2) Risk controls: Any up-front credit should be tied to measurable milestones (signed SOW + onboarding milestone at 30 days + volume ramp triggers). If they miss ramp, we claw back or apply future invoice adjustments.
3) Size/throughput: The 4 -> 8 pool looks reasonable; ask infra about pre-warming and KV cache sizing.

I can greenlight up to $150k in one-time credit with milestones and a 12-month commit. If Monica argues for $200k, I need a short writeup on projected 12-month ARR and reference value. Laura — can you run a quick ARR delta analysis from the attached workbook and confirm cashflow timing (credit amortization)?

If we get stakeholder sign-off, I'll provide an exception approval note for legal/finance to use in the term sheet.

-Vivek
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 02 May 2027 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Dedicated GPU pool — special pricing & throughput guarantee

Vivek/Monica — ran the quick analysis. Key points:

- If Nova signs the 12-month commit at the forecasted volumes in the attached worksheet, ARR impact is ~$1.1M (net of the proposed $150k credit amortized over 12 months).
- Cashflow: credit reduces month-1 cash by $150k; net present value acceptable with standard revenue recognition.
- Recommendation: approve $150k credit with milestone clawbacks (30-day onboarding, 90-day volume ramp to 60% of forecast). Add a clause: if ramp < 40% at 90 days, credit recapture on remaining invoices.

Monica — with that I recommend we proceed with the $150k concession and include the throughput SLA in the commercial exhibit. I'll draft the commercial paragraph you can drop into the term sheet.

-Laura
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evan Brooks <evan@novaanalytics.com>, Procurement <procurement@novaanalytics.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 02 May 2027 11:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated GPU pool — special pricing & throughput guarantee

Evan — thanks for your patience. Following internal review we can offer the following:

1) Commercial: 12-month reserved commit with a one-time $150,000 commercial credit applied to the first invoice. Credit is contingent on signed contract and the following milestones: successful onboarding within 30 days and a ramp target of >= 60% forecast volume by day 90. Failure to meet the 90-day ramp <40% triggers partial recapture on remaining invoices as outlined in the attached exhibit.

2) Technical: Dedicated GPU pool sized at 4x A100-equivalent for steady state with autoscale to 8 GPUs for bursts. We will provide a throughput SLA: p99 token latency <= 120ms for requests up to 100 r/s for the specified average token length. SLA remedies are credits capped at 10% of monthly invoice and detailed in the SLA exhibit.

3) Next steps: I've attached an updated pricing workbook and SLA exhibit. If you accept, I will send a term sheet and DocuSign link for signature. Procurement: please confirm the SOC2 evidence request and I will route the security pack.

DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/sign/ABC-NA-2027
HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.redwood/deals/NA-2027-07

Regards,
Monica Patel
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
